notes: 2018_01 is the employee handbook (fragmented recovered text, often one word per line). 2018_06 (tenure regulations: a partial transcription and a scanned PDF of 13 pages) holds no leave provisions apart from II.B (leave and the probationary period) and II.H (political leave).

Faculty coverage. The handbook 'applies to all New Mexico Tech employees unless otherwise excluded'. Sections 22 (Leave: annual and sick leave), 24 (Leave With Pay), 25 (Emergency Leave), 26 (Leave Without Pay), 27 (Donated Leave) and 28 are headed 'Does not Apply to Faculty'; sick leave also says 'This policy does not pertain to Faculty'. Section 23 (Family Medical Leave, including the newborn, adoption and foster-care leave paragraph) and Section 21 (Employee Benefits, including the Long Term Disability Program) carry no faculty exclusion. So for tenure-stream faculty the saved sources give FMLA (c1), the LTD programme (c9, terms not saved) and the tenure-clock provision (c10, general purpose); the staff provisions c2-c8 are recorded and flagged excludes_main_faculty.

The rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3): missing is false, because two usable sources are governing documents that cover tenure-stream faculty: the handbook's Section 23 leave policy (no faculty exclusion) and the Regulations Governing Academic Freedom and Tenure (a tenure-clock provision, II.B). Missing governing document: no saved source states faculty sick leave, faculty paid leave or any faculty parental or modified-duties policy; the handbook excludes faculty from its sick and annual leave but names no faculty leave policy that replaces them, so no cross_reference_not_saved flag can name it. The faculty figures here rest on FMLA alone.

2018_05 (April 2018 handbook) and 2018_07 (2019 parental workload reduction) postdate the reference date and are not used. The 2015 handbook's last pages (after page 109: the Policy Signature and Approval Document) were lost in the truncated PDF; the table of contents shows no leave section there.

Not components (a parent cannot use them for a birth, or not leave): inclement-weather administrative leave, driver's-licence leave without pay, holidays, jury and witness duty, time to vote, military training leave, funeral leave, II.H political leave, return to work on a restricted basis after illness or injury (a discretionary accommodation for any illness), FMLA intermittent-leave transfer to an alternate position (part of the statute's operation), workers' compensation sick-leave crediting.

Cited but not saved: Long Term Disability Program description (HR Office; flagged on c9); Family Medical Leave Request form and medical certification forms; benefit plan descriptions (health, life, Flex Plan); Educational Retirement Plan booklet; Intellectual property policy (Academic Affairs); 1940 AAUP Statement of Principles and 1984 AAUP Policy Documents and Reports (cited in the tenure regulations). None is a parental-leave provision except the LTD description.

Chain, birth parent (tenure-stream faculty): FMLA unpaid leave up to 12 weeks (c1); LTD plan without a stated length (c9). Staff-only chain (excluded): sick leave within FMLA (c2) -> annual leave (c3) -> medical leave without pay up to 1 year (c4).
Chain, non-birth parent (tenure-stream faculty): FMLA unpaid leave up to 12 weeks (c1). Staff-only: emergency leave up to 3 days for a life-threatening family illness (c7).

Statutory baseline (US): FMLA coded as c1 (verified against statute texts 2026_00 and 2026_01); FEPLA not applicable. No New Mexico state rows in the baseline; the documents name no New Mexico leave statute.
